title: AI for Science
tagline: How AI is changing biology and chemistry: protein folding, AlphaFold, protein language models, protein design, molecules in Python, and AI weather models.
prereqs: Deep Learning (transformers help). Graph Neural Networks helps for the molecule steps. No biology background needed; step 1 covers it.

projects: Fold a small protein with ColabFold and compare it with its experimental structure from the PDB.
Use RDKit to compute properties for 100 drug molecules from SMILES and plot which ones pass Lipinski's rule of five.
Train a DeepChem graph model to predict solubility on the ESOL dataset and report its error on a held-out split.
